src: APPSC Junior Assistant cum Typist in Prisons & Correctional
s: Which of the following is not a key area of the vision of Digital India Programme?
o: Infrastructure as a utility to every Citizen
x: Digital India's three vision areas are digital infrastructure as a utility to every citizen, governance and services on demand, and digital empowerment of citizens; 'digital application for export promotion' is not one.

src: APPSC Forest Range Officer Mains Paper-I General Studies & M
s: Which of these is not part of the Digital India initiative?
x: Digital infrastructure, services on demand and digital empowerment are Digital India's vision areas; issuing a digital currency (an RBI function) is not part of it.

src: UPSC CSE Prelims 2018
s:
Which of the following is/are the aims of the "Digital India" Plan of the Government of India?
1. Formation of India's own Internet companies, like China did.
2. Establish a policy framework to encourage overseas multinational corporations that collect Big Data to build their large data centres within our national geographical boundaries.
3. Connect many of our villages to the Internet and bring Wi-Fi to many of our schools, public places and major tourist centres.
Select the correct answer using the code given below:
x: Digital India aims to connect villages to the internet and bring Wi-Fi to schools, public places and tourist centres (3). Building India's own internet companies 'like China' and a framework for overseas data centres are not its aims (UPSC 2018 key b).

src: I.A.S. (Pre) 2018
s:
Which of the following is/are the aim/aims of 'Digital India' Plan of the Government of India?
1. Formation of India's own Internet companies like China did.
2. Establish a policy framework to encourage overseas multinational corporations that collect Big Data to build their large data centres within our national geographical boundaries.
3. Connect many of our villages to the Internet and bring Wi-Fi to many of our schools, public places and major tourist centres.
Select the correct answer using the code given below:
x: Only statement 3 (connect villages, Wi-Fi in schools and public places) is a Digital India aim.

src: APPSC Zilla Sainik Welfare Officer in Sainik Welfare Service
s: Which of the following is responsible for the implementation of the Digital India Programme?
o: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology
Ministry of Information Technology and Communications
x: Digital India is coordinated and implemented by the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY).

src: APPSC Group-I 2017
s: The mission of the Government of India for electronic delivery of all Government services is known as
x: e-Kranti, a pillar of Digital India, is the mission for electronic delivery of all government services across sectors.

src: APPSC Dr. NTR University of Health Sciences Mains Paper-II I
s: Which of the following is NOT one of the key areas on which the vision of Digital India is centred?
o: Digital Infrastructure as a Utility to Every Citizen
x: Digital India's three vision areas are digital infrastructure as a utility to every citizen, governance and services on demand, and digital empowerment of citizens; 'digital commerce and trade' is not one.

src: M.P. P.C.S. (Pre) 2025
s: The correct sequence of four phases of Gartner's Evolution Model of E-Governance is :
x: Gartner's four phases of e-government are Information → Interaction → Transaction → Transformation.

src: M.P. P.C.S. (Pre) 2024
s: What are the four pillars of E-Governance?
x: The four pillars of e-governance are People, Process, Technology and Resources.

src: M.P. P.C.S. (Pre) 2022
s: Which description is appropriate among the following for e-governance?
o: To engage, enable and empower the citizens
To provide fair and unbiased decision to the citizens
To ensure people's faith in e-commerce
x: Printed key: technology-driven governance, i.e. using ICT to deliver governance. 'Engage, enable and empower citizens' describes e-governance's aim and is the tempting option.

src: UPSC CSE Prelims 2007
s: MCA‑21 is a major initiative taken up by the Government of India in which one of the following areas?
x: MCA21 is the Ministry of Corporate Affairs' e-governance Mission Mode Project for online company filings and services (UPSC 2007).

src: APPSC Assistant Statistical Officer & Other Posts General St
s: Which ministry launched Phase III of the capacity-building initiatives to boost digital governance under the Digital India vision in September 2024?
o: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology
x: The Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (through NeGD, with NISG) launched Phase III of its capacity-building initiatives in September 2024, in line with the Digital India vision.

src: APPSC AEE (Civil), AMVI, Agriculture Officer and Other Posts
s: Name the e-Governance initiative launched in the year 2024 to accelerate e-Governance services in India
x: GI Cloud 'MeghRaj' was launched by MeitY to accelerate delivery of e-services while optimising ICT spending. It was launched in February 2014, so '2024' in the stem is a misprint; MyGov (2014) is citizen engagement, ARPANET is the US forerunner of the internet and Digital India came in 2015.

src: APPSC Assistant Environmental Engineer and Analyst Grade-II
s:
Identify the option that arranges the following digital initiatives launched by the Government of India in chronological order.

1. Aadhaar

2. MyGov

3. PM eVIDYA

4. ONDC (Open Network for Digital Commerce)
x: Aadhaar (2009-10) came first, then MyGov (July 2014), PM eVIDYA (2020) and ONDC (2021-22): 1-2-3-4.

src: APPSC 2023 Screening test (Online Mode) to the post of Deput
s: In March 2024, which of the following unveiled BhashaNet portal at Universal Acceptance (UA) Day on 21st March 2024 for Digital Inclusion across the nation?
o: Council of Scientific & Industrial Research (CSIR) and Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY)
NITI Aayog and Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY)
National Internet Exchange of India (NIXI) and Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY)
National Internet Exchange of India (NIXI) and Council of Scientific & Industrial Research (CSIR)
x: BhashaNet was unveiled by NIXI together with MeitY on Universal Acceptance Day, 21 March 2024; CSIR and NITI Aayog are not involved.

src: APPSC Extension Officer Grade-I Common Paper General Studies
s: What is the full form of SWAYAM?
at: Study Webs of Active Learning for Young Aspiring Minds
x: SWAYAM = Study Webs of Active-Learning for Young Aspiring Minds, the national MOOC platform for higher education.

src: CDS 2019
s: What is SWAYAM?
o: Study Webs of Active-Learning for Young Aspiring Minds.
Study Webs of Active-Learning for Young Aspiration Minds.
Study Webs of Active-Learning for Young Aspiration Minds.
Study Webs of Active-Learning for Youth Aspiration Minds.
x: SWAYAM stands for Study Webs of Active-Learning for Young Aspiring Minds; the other options alter 'Young Aspiring'.

src: APPSC Junior Lecturers 2003
s: Which of the following cities has India's first 'Techno Park'?
x: Technopark, Thiruvananthapuram (1990) was India's first technology park. Gurgaon, Pune and Bangalore came later.

src: Asst Director in A.P. Economics & Statistical Services 2012
s: The National Knowledge Network (NKN) is designed by
o: All India Council for Technical Education
x: The National Knowledge Network (NKN), a multi-gigabit network linking universities, research labs and libraries, was designed and is implemented by the National Informatics Centre (NIC); UGC, AICTE and the National Library are only users.

src: APPSC Junior Lecturers General Studies & Mental Ability 2020
s: In which year was the National e-Governance Division created by Central Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology?
x: The National e-Governance Division (NeGD) was created in 2009 by MeitY (then DeitY) as an independent business division under Media Lab Asia (now Digital India Corporation); it now runs UMANG, DigiLocker and Meri Pehchaan.

src: Asst Engineer in Health & Municipal 2012
s: Which of the following is not a major IT Company in India?
x: Raymond is a textile and apparel company; CMC (now part of TCS), Infosys and TCS are IT companies.

src: Asst. Director in A.P. Economics & Statistical Services 2011
s: The former Chairman of the Infosys IT Company was
x: N.R. Narayana Murthy co-founded Infosys (1981) and was its chairman; the other names are distractors.

src: TSPSC Assistant Engineers 2018
s: ITIR stands for
x: ITIR = Information Technology Investment Region: the 2008 policy resolution (Ministry of Communications and IT) for large delineated regions (about 40 sq km) for IT, ITES and electronic hardware units, e.g. Bengaluru, Hyderabad. It is not 'International' or 'Industrial'.

src: APPSC General Studies & Mental Ability (Common Paper for Var
s: What is the role of technology in e-governance?
o: To enhance citizen engagement and improve service delivery
x: Technology in e-governance aims to enhance citizen engagement and improve service delivery, bringing transparency, reliability and efficiency; it is not meant to replace human interaction or increase control.

src: APPSC AEE General Studies & Mental Abilities 2023
s: Which of the following portals/softwares can be used to apply for a new driving license in India as of 1 June 2023?
x: SARATHI (MoRTH) handles driving licences; VAHAN handles vehicle registration. HAMRAAZ is the Army's app and MADAD the consular grievance portal.

src: APPSC AE (Environmental) Mains General Studies & Mental Abil
s: What is the name of the electronic single window system recently deployed by the Election Commission of India for the political parties and candidates seeking different permissions during the electioneering phase?
x: ECI's Suvidha portal is the single-window system for candidates and parties to seek permissions (rallies, vehicles, meetings) during campaigning; Suvidha 2.0 app came in Oct 2024.

src: APPSC Executive Officer Gr-III Endowment Paper-I General Stu
s: The Integrated Pensioners Portal, ...... was launched at Vigyan Bhawan New Delhi on 18 October 2022.
x: The Integrated Pensioners' Portal launched by Dr Jitendra Singh at Vigyan Bhawan on 18 Oct 2022 used Bhavishya 9.0 as the base, integrating SBI's Pension Seva portal with Bhavishya.

src: APPSC Hostel Welfare Officers (Grade-II) General Studies & M
s: UMANG is a unified mobile app for:
x:
UMANG then offered about 1,200 services — now 2,400+ services (July 2026) (app notes 5:24 sub 4)
UMANG (2017, NeGD-MeitY) is one app for central, state and local government services; the exam answer counted about 1,200 services (now 2,400+).

src: APPSC AEE (S2) 2023
s: UMANG provides a single platform for all Indian Citizens to access pan India e-Gov services ranging from Central to Local Government bodies. UMANG is an acronym for
o: Unified Mobile Application for New-age Governance
Unlimited Mobile Access for Neo Governance
Unilateral Mobile Application for Nodal Governance
Uninterrupted Mobile Access for National Governance
x: UMANG = Unified Mobile Application for New-age Governance (NeGD-MeitY, launched 1 Nov 2017).

src: TSPSC Transport & Excise Constables 2016
s: What is meant by ANUBHAV?
o: Application related to the safety of women
The online platform (software) started by the Department of Pension & Pensioners.
The newly introduced coast guard ship
x: Anubhav is the online platform of the Department of Pension & Pensioners' Welfare where retiring central employees record their experiences; it is now part of Bhavishya 9.0.

src: R.A.S./R.T.S. (Pre) 2024
s: Which organization has recently launched an upgraded Mobile App 'Suvidha 2.0'?
x: The Election Commission of India launched the upgraded Suvidha 2.0 app in October 2024 for candidates and parties to apply for campaign permissions.

src: CDS 2018
s: Which one of the following is correct about ‘Aaykar Setu’?
o: It is a mechanism for achieving excellence in public sector delivery related to GST.
With the use of a mobile app, it facilitates online payment of taxes.
It is a communication strategy designed to collect information and build a database of tax defaulters.
It enables electronic filing and processing of import and export declarations.
x: Aaykar Setu (2017) is the Income Tax Department's module/mobile app for online tax payment, PAN-Aadhaar linking and tax tools; ICEGATE handles import-export filing.

src: APPSC Assistant Statistical Officer & Other Posts General St
s: Which of the following is NOT a primary objective of the government's policy to use technology?
o: Enhancing the delivery of citizen services
Reducing the need for government personnel.
Investing in wireless technologies and mobile applications.
x: Government's technology policy aims at better citizen services, security and investment in wireless/mobile technologies; reducing the need for government personnel is not a stated primary objective.

src: U.P.P.C.S. (Pre) 2017
s: SEZ India mobile app has been launched in January 2017 by:
x: The SEZ India app was launched on 15 January 2017 by the Ministry of Commerce and Industry (SEZ division, Department of Commerce).

src: APPSC AEE General Studies & Mental Abilities 2023
s: The National Single Sign-on platform launched by the Government of India in July 2002, to facilitate/provide citizens ease of access to government portals is called ____.
x: Meri Pehchaan, the National Single Sign-On launched by MeitY in July 2022 (the stem's '2002' is a misprint), gives one login to government portals; MyScheme and MyGov are other platforms.

src: APPSC 2023 Lecturers in Government Degree Colleges
s: Which of the following is the National e-Authentication service offered by Department of Electronics and Information Technology?
x: e-Pramaan is the National e-Authentication framework of MeitY (then DeitY), built by C-DAC; DigiLocker is a document locker.

src: APPSC Town Planning Building Overseers General Studies & Men
s: Which of the following statement is CORRECT with reference to the Tele-Law programme of Indian Government?
o: The Tele-Law program is exclusively designed for medical advice and consultation
The Tele-Law program is limited to urban areas and does not extend to rural areas
The Tele-Law program provides legal aid exclusively through physical meetings at Common Service Centres
The Tele-Law programme is an e-interface mechanism to seek legal advice and consultation at a pre-litigation stage
x: Tele-Law is an e-interface (via CSCs and video/phone) to get legal advice at the pre-litigation stage, mainly for rural people.

src: APPSC Town Planning Building Overseers General Studies & Men
s: In which year, MeeSeva started with 10 services in Andhra Pradesh?
x: MeeSeva was launched on 4 November 2011 (Chittoor district) by the undivided AP government, starting with a small set of revenue and registration services.

src: APPSC 2021 Mains Junior Assistant Cum Computer Assistant In
s: What is the approximate count of MeeSeva authorised agents (working and non-working) in Andhra Pradesh as of January 2023?
x: About 11,079 MeeSeva centres and authorised agents (working and non-working) existed in Andhra Pradesh in January 2023.

src: APPSC Combined Recruitment (Hostel Welfare Officer, Division
s: The Aadhar-enabled webland-based biometric system was introduced for the first time in Andhra Pradesh for the distribution of groundnut seeds during the Kharif season of ____.
x: AP's Aadhaar-enabled, webland-linked biometric distribution of subsidised groundnut seed began in Kharif 2016 (Anantapur, 63 mandals, May 2016); NextGen notes the NIC-AP e-Seed system's impact 'since 2017' when it went statewide.

src: APPSC Town Planning Building Overseers 2023
s: In which year, Government of Andhra Pradesh issued Andhra Pradesh Information Technology Rules (Electronic Service Delivery) in order to provide legal sanctity to the digitally signed certificates and make it mandatory for the Departments to migrate to electronic service delivery within a period of three years?
x: The AP Information Technology (Electronic Service Delivery) Rules, 2011 (G.O.Ms.No.10, ITC dept, 18 Oct 2011) gave legal sanctity to digitally signed MeeSeva certificates and set a timeline for departments to move to electronic delivery.

src: APPSC Divisional Accounts Officer (Mains) General Studies &
s: Which of these service is NOT available under online Citizen Friendly Services of Transport (CFST) department?
x: AP Transport's online Citizen Friendly Services (CFST) cover learner licences, tax tokens and transfer of ownership; payment of utility bills is a MeeSeva/e-Seva service.

src: APPSC Junior Lecturers General Studies & Mental Ability 2020
s: Which one of the following is NOT an e-government project of the state of Andhra Pradesh?
x: e-Mitra is Rajasthan's e-governance project; e-Pragati, MeeSeva and APSWAN are Andhra Pradesh's.

src: APPSC Assistant BC Welfare Officer and Royalty Inspector in
s: Which of the following is a framework that provides integrated services to citizens through free flow of information launched by Andhra Pradesh Government?
x: e-Pragati is AP's whole-of-government framework in which all e-governance systems are interconnected and integrated to provide services online.

src: APPSC Group-III Mains Panchayat Secretary (Grade-IV) Paper-I
s: The Government of Andhra Pradesh, for bringing the governance & the entire service delivery mechanism closer to the households seeks to establish ____
x: AP set up Village/Ward Secretariats (2 Oct 2019) to bring governance and service delivery closer to households.

src: APPSC 2023 Screening test (Online Mode) to the post of Deput
s: Which e-governance initiative in Andhra Pradesh started in November, 2011 focuses on providing citizens with a single platform for various government services and transactions?
x: MeeSeva (Nov 2011) is AP's single-window platform for government services; Amma Vodi and Navaratnalu are welfare schemes and Rythu Bandhu is Telangana's.

src: APPSC Extension Officer Grade-I Common Paper General Studies
s: What is the purpose for launching Bhuseva and Bhudaar web portals?
x: BhuSeva and the Bhudaar portal (Nov 2018) put AP's land records online, giving each land parcel an 11-digit Bhudaar number.

src: APPSC Forest Section Officer Screening Test General Studies
s: Which scheme has been launched to achieve 'Sunrise AP 2022'?
x: e-Pragati, AP's state enterprise architecture, was launched as the digital backbone to achieve the 'Sunrise AP 2022' vision.

src: APPSC Junior Lecturers General Studies & Mental Ability 2020
s: Which of the following is the web portal of Andhra Pradesh through which people can view land records online?
x: BhuSeva and Bhudaar are AP's web portals for viewing land records online; the others are welfare schemes.

src: M.P. P.C.S. (Pre) 2023
s: Which of the following is not an E-Procurement portal?
x: MP Online is the MP government's citizen-services portal, not an e-procurement portal; MP Tenders, GeM and MP LUN are procurement platforms.

src: APPSC Group-1 PYQ
s: Which of the following has recently acquired the status of the world's first complete E- Networked rural district in India?
x: Malappuram (Kerala), through the Akshaya project, became the first fully e-literate / e-networked rural district.

s: Identify the incorrect statement about the e-Governance programmes in India.
o: KHAJANE is an e-Governance project for the computerized delivery of land records to farmers of Karnataka
BHOOMI is an online delivery of land records in Karnataka
eSeva is an e-Governance initiative of Andhra Pradesh
FRIENDS is an e-Governance initiative of Kerala
x: Khajane is Karnataka's computerised treasury system, not land records (Bhoomi does land records), so statement 1 is incorrect; eSeva (AP) and FRIENDS (Kerala) are correct.

src: M.P.P.C.S. (Pre) 2017
s: The first Indian State to start State Data Centre (SDC) is–
x: Himachal Pradesh's State Data Centre at Mehli, Shimla (inaugurated June 2016 by CM Virbhadra Singh) is credited as the first SDC, on the green data-centre concept.

src: APPSC Zilla Sainik Welfare Officer in Sainik Welfare Service
s: Which was the first state to launch the e-Cabinet System in India?
x:
Most books and keys: Himachal Pradesh (end-to-end e-Cabinet, Feb 2021). Strictly: Andhra Pradesh held the first e-cabinet meeting (iPads) in September 2014 (madhyamam.com).
Himachal Pradesh is credited as the first state to adopt a full e-Cabinet (paperless cabinet application, Feb 2021).

src: M.P.P.C.S. (Pre) 2017
s: The first Indian State to start State Data Centre (SDC) is :
x: Himachal Pradesh's State Data Centre at Mehli, Shimla (June 2016) is credited as the first SDC, built on the green data-centre concept.

src: APPSC AEE Mains General Studies & Mental Ability 2016
s: The National Award for e-governance in 2015-16 for excellence in Government Process Re-engineering was awarded to the project
x: The 2015-16 National Award for e-Governance (Gold) for excellence in Government Process Re-engineering went to COSMOS (Chhattisgarh Online School Monitoring System), Balrampur; MAHA-GEOMIN won in the GIS category. Moved to e-governance programmes.

src: APPSC Group-III Panchayat Secretary Mains Paper-II Rural Dev
s: What is the name of the Software used by most of the States for maintenance of Panchayat Accounts?
x: PRIASoft (Panchayati Raj Institutions Accounting Software) under e-Panchayat is the accounting software most States use for panchayat accounts.

src: Polytechnic Lecturers 2011
s: The latest system of governance which is mainly based on the Information Technology (IT) is
x: E-Governance is governance based on ICT for delivering government services; good/corporate/SMART governance are wider concepts not defined by IT.

src: Uttarakhand P.C.S. (Mains) 2006
s: The use of Computers in Governance known as –
x: The use of computers and ICT in governance for delivering government services is called E-Governance.

src: APPSC AEE General Studies & Mental Abilities 2023
s: The National e-Governance Plan was approved by the Union Cabinet in May ____.
x: The National e-Governance Plan (27 MMPs + 10 components) was approved by the Union Government on 18 May 2006.

src: APPSC Forest Range Officer Mains Paper-I General Studies & M
s: The vision of the National e-Governance Plan is
o: To provide public services to common man in his locality at affordable cost
To make every one computer literate
To provide public services free of cost right at home
To deliver all public services through online only
x: NeGP vision: make all government services accessible to the common man in his locality through common service delivery outlets, with efficiency, transparency and reliability at affordable costs; not free of cost or online-only.

src: APPSC 2025 Welfare Organiser
s: The National e - Governance Plan , 2006 identified how many Mission Mode Projects ( MMPs ) ?
x: NeGP 2006 listed 27 MMPs (9 Central, 11 State, 7 Integrated) and 10 components; 31 and 44 (e-Kranti) are later expansions.

src: APPSC 2023 Lecturers in Government Degree Colleges
s: The eCourt Project, an integrated Mission Mode Project for the ICT development of the Indian judiciary, has been under implementation since which of the following years?
x: e-Courts, an Integrated MMP for ICT enablement of the judiciary, has been under implementation since 2007 (Phase I).

src: APPSC Assistant Telugu Translator General Studies & Mental A
s: Which of the following is a project floated under the National e-Governance Programme under mission mode?
x: e-Panchayat is a State Mission Mode Project under NeGP.

src: APPSC 2023 Screening test (Online Mode) to the post of Deput
s: In February 2024, APAAR was launched by Ministry of Education through Common Service Centres (CSCs) in remote villages of India. What is the full form of APAAR?
x: APAAR = Automated Permanent Academic Account Registry ('One Nation One Student ID'), launched by the Ministry of Education through CSCs in February 2024.

src: APPSC Extension Officer Grade-I Common Paper (General Studie
s: Who has launched Shiksha Vani app?
x: Shiksha Vani is the podcast app of CBSE.

src: APPSC Group-IV Prelims General Studies & Mental Ability 2022
s: "Pariksha Sangam" portal was launched by which institution?
x: Pariksha Sangam (2022) is CBSE's integrated portal for examination-related processes.

src: APPSC 2022 Forest Range Officers
s: Which company will provide end-to-end management of DIKSHA’s online platforms across its mobile application and website, and will be made accessible to students for free educational content in their preferred Indian language?
x: Bharti Airtel was chosen to manage DIKSHA's app and website end to end; DIKSHA belongs to NCERT/Ministry of Education.

src: APPSC Hostel Welfare Officer Grade-II (Male & Female) in AP
s: National Digital Repository to store, index, preserve, distribute and share the digital learning resources developed by the Open and Distance Learning Institutions in the country is known as?
x: eGyanKosh (IGNOU) is the national digital repository for learning resources of Open and Distance Learning institutions; Gyandarshan and Gyanvani are TV and radio channels.

src: Grama Ward Sachivalayam Category-I Panchayat Secretary / Mah
s: "Aarogya Sethu App" was launched by Government of India on April 2020. This App was developed by
o: International Committee on Taxonomy of Viruses
x: Aarogya Setu (April 2020) was developed by the National Informatics Centre under MeitY.

src: Jharkhand P.C.S. (Pre) 2016
s: The web portal DACNET is related to :
x: DACNET (Department of Agriculture and Cooperation Network) is the e-Agriculture portal run by NIC.

src: APPSC Hostel Welfare Officers (Grade-II) General Studies & M
s: Name the Union Minister who launched the "e-governance initiatives for ST Welfare schemes".
x: Union Tribal Affairs Minister Arjun Munda launched the e-governance initiatives for ST welfare schemes (scholarship portals, DBT tracking).

src: APPSC Assistant Director of Fisheries in A.P. Fisheries Serv
s: What is the name of the web portal launched by Survey of India on the 250th Anniversary?
x: Survey of India launched the 'Nakshe' web portal (free downloadable topographic maps) on its 250th anniversary in 2017. Off-topic for AP ICT, moved to e-governance portals.

src: APPSC Group-IV Paper-I Mains 2023
s: Which of the following statements about the 'Amantran' portal launched by Rajnath Singh in January 2023 is INCORRECT?
o: It will be used to extend e-invitations to dignitaries/guests and for the online sale of tickets to the general public for witnessing Republic Day and Independence Day events.
It contains QR code-based authentication for enhanced security.
Passes/tickets will be delivered digitally through emails/sms.
The passes/tickets can be easily cancelled/transferred.
x: The Aamantran portal (MoD, 6 Jan 2023) sends e-invitations and sells Republic Day/Independence Day tickets with QR-code authentication and digital delivery by email/SMS; its tickets are non-cancellable and non-transferable, so statement d is the incorrect one. (PIB says it was launched by Raksha Rajya Mantri Ajay Bhatt, not Rajnath Singh.)

src: APPSC Forest Beat Officer & Assistant Beat Officer Screening
s: The Government-led initiative in India that provides a secure online platform to store and share digital documents is
x: DigiLocker (MeitY, Feb 2015) is a secure cloud locker to store and share digital documents, linked to Aadhaar.

src: Junior Lecturers 2020
s: The Government of India is testing a prototype of an Indian equivalent of popular messaging platforms, such as WhatsApp and Telegram, for secure internal use. What is the name of this platform?
x: GIMS = Government Instant Messaging System, NIC's in-house WhatsApp/Telegram alternative for government use, released as the Sandes app.

src: APPSC Group-IV Prelims General Studies & Mental Ability 2022
s: "Hyderabad Declaration" is associated with...
x: The Hyderabad Declaration was adopted at the 22nd National Conference on e-Governance (Hyderabad, October 2019).

src: APPSC Forest Range Officers Mains General Studies & Mental A
s: Dactylography is the study of:
x: Dactylography (dactyloscopy) is the study of fingerprints for identification; the retina and face are other biometrics used by Aadhaar-type systems.

src: APPSC Zilla Sainik Welfare Officer in Sainik Welfare Service
s: Who was the first citizen of India to receive a twelve digit Aadhaar Number?
x: Ranjana Sonawane of Tembhli village (Nandurbar, Maharashtra) received the first Aadhaar number on 29 September 2010.

src: APPSC Group-III Panchayat Secretary Mains Paper-I General St
s: When was the Unique Identification Authority of India (UIDAI) established?
x: UIDAI was set up on 28 January 2009 as an attached office of the Planning Commission; it became statutory under the Aadhaar Act 2016.

src: APPSC Group-1 PYQ
s: The first set of Identity Numbers as per the Unique Identification Authority of India will be issued in:
x:
Official key / most books: February 2011 (UIDAI's planned date). Strictly: the first Aadhaar number was issued on 29 September 2010 at Tembhli (app notes 5:25 sub 1).
UIDAI's plan was to issue the first set of UID numbers between August 2010 and February 2011, so the exam key is February 2011; the first number was actually issued on 29 September 2010.

src: APPSC Group-2 PYQ
s: The statutory authority, Unique Identification Authority of India (UIDAI), works under the Ministryof:
x: UIDAI is a statutory authority (Aadhaar Act 2016) under the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology.

src: APPSC 2018 Question Papers and Keys for Mains Exams
s: The statutory authority, Unique Identification Authority of India (UIDAI), works under the Ministryof:
x: UIDAI is a statutory authority (Aadhaar Act 2016) under the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology.

src: APPSC Group-III Panchayat Secretary Mains Paper-I General St
s: Which of the following is not a correct statement?
o: 120 Crore persons enrolled under AADHAAR till june, 2017
AADHAAR is a 12 digit unique number
It is mandatory now to link cell phone number of individuals with AADHAAR
At present there is no policy to take back if a person wants to give up AADHAAR
x:
mobile-Aadhaar linking was mandated in 2017 — now not mandatory: the Supreme Court (Puttaswamy, 26 Sept 2018) held Aadhaar cannot be required for mobile connections (Wikipedia Aadhaar, citing Al Jazeera 26 Sep 2018).
About 115 crore people had enrolled by June 2017 (115.15 crore, Centre's affidavit to the Supreme Court, 10 June 2017), so '120 crore' was the wrong statement; Aadhaar is a 12-digit number, mobile-Aadhaar linking was then mandated (now not mandatory, SC 2018) and there was no opt-out policy.

src: APPSC Degree Lecturers 2011
s: Unique Identity Number is under:
x:
UIDAI was under the Planning Commission — now a statutory authority under MeitY (Aadhaar Act 2016) (app notes 5:25 sub 2)
UIDAI was set up in January 2009 as an attached office of the Planning Commission (now it works under MeitY).

src: APPSC Lecturers in Govt Degree Colleges Paper-I General Stud

src: APPSC Group-1 PYQ
s:
Consider the following
Assertion (A) and
Reason (R) and choose the correct code:
Assertion (A): 'India Stack' has enabled an online, paperless and cashless digital access to various public and private services. This has reduced the cost of conducting e-KYC.
Reason (R): India Stack consists of two interconnected layers, and of these, the 'Payment Layer' has reduced the cost of conducting e-KYC.
o: Both (A) and (R) are true and (R) explains (A)
Both (A) and (R) are true, but (R) does not explain (A)
x: A is true: India Stack gives presence-less, paperless, cashless access and cuts e-KYC cost. R is false: India Stack has more than two layers (identity, payments, documents, consent), and it is the identity layer (Aadhaar e-KYC), not the payments layer, that lowers e-KYC cost.

src: APPSC Junior Assistant in Dr. NTR University of Health Scien
s:
Which of the following conclusions can be drawn from the given statement?
The IT and ITES sectors in India are growing due to digitalisation, cloud technologies, and high demand for IT services, but a talent gap in fields like cyber-security and data science remains. Government initiatives like 'Future Skills PRIME' aim to address this gap through upskilling programs.
o: The IT and ITES sectors are facing no workforce challenges.
Government initiatives are focused on bridging the skill gap in emerging technologies.
Cloud technologies are irrelevant to the growth of IT and ITES sectors.
IT positions are in low demand globally.

s:
